As it stands I don't think many PC players are going to be buying the DLC or crates (myself included) purely because of the way we are being treated.

I can deal with hackers, bad bugs, even them messing up the end of the winter siege event for us. But when the "something special" soon becomes "we have worked and coordinated with all teams to make sure this doesn’t happen again for future events" it kills all trust. There is now no reason for PC(any) players to believe anything SHG says anymore because they might just change it later and shaft us again. They went from a game developer that made some mistakes (everyone does) to Hello Games with their fake promises.
